verdict.rationale: Unit is a banking-infrastructure platform with a Dashboard and APIs that expose customer, account, and transaction data. Surfacing AI-generated insights from that data is a fair axis for this kind of product, but nothing in the evidence pack describes AI-generated insights, suggestions, or any AI analysis feature in the product. Access to raw data through the Dashboard or APIs is not the same as AI-generated insight.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
